column1: # Pattern-matching sites in hooks/validate-bash.sh — the population the backlog row 8942f3b1506d
# 2026-09-09 (row 6293bf3bbbf1) — POPULATION CHANGE, recorded rather than absorbed. S32
#   (`grep -qE '[$`*?]'` in _rm_literal_assignment) is GONE: that single blanket refusal is what made
#   the scratchpad rm-allowlist unreachable for a chained variable path, and it is replaced by `case`
#   patterns, which are not grep sites. It was pinned EQUIVALENT, so no DIVERGENT counterexample was
#   lost and the non-vacuity floor is untouched. S31/S28/S29/S30 only MOVED (1248->1268, 1289->1323,
#   1304->1338, 1307->1341); their patterns and pinned verdicts are unchanged. Net: the hook has one
#   fewer grep on the hottest path in the fleet, which is the direction row 8942f3b1506d wanted.
#   id            stable id used in the report and the doc
#   line          line number in hooks/validate-bash.sh (checked by the harness — an edit that
#                 moves a site makes the coverage assertion FAIL, which is the point)
#   form          grep invocation form: qE | qiE | oE | qF
#   feed          how the subject reaches grep: raw (printf '%s') | nl (echo, adds \n) |
#                 pipeline (site 599 only: sed|tr|sed splits into MULTIPLE LINES first)
#   subject       what is matched: whole (all of $CMD — can be multi-line) | line (one extracted
#                 occurrence, newline-free by construction) | clause (tr ';|' '\n' split —
#                 newline-free) | token (one argv token) | stream (a multi-line stream)
#   verify        lit  = `pattern` must appear literally on that line of the hook (drift check)
#                 syn  = pattern is synthesised at runtime (interpolated flag / ${PWD##*/}), so
#                        no literal check is possible; recorded here as the instantiated form
#   expect        EQUIVALENT | DIVERGENT — the MEASURED verdict this corpus pins. The harness
#                 fails if reality no longer matches, in EITHER direction (a site that stops
#                 diverging means the corpus lost its counterexample = a vacuous control).
#   pattern       the ERE (or literal, for qF) exactly as the hook has it
